text:
Liam Park: quick triage: Auric private deploy stalled on KMS permission and audit log delivery. can we run through checklist?

Noor Khan: saw the pipeline error: AccessDenied for kms:GenerateDataKey. ask them to paste the key policy and the CI sts arn.

Diego Ruiz: they gave role arn: arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/auric-ci. common issue is they used the assumed-role session as principal. request `aws sts get-caller-identity` output from the CI job.

Liam Park: asked customer to run that and to share their SIEM endpoint DNS -> IP mapping. infra-bot shows outbound resets to 172.31.55.9:443 from our NAT.

Noor Khan: for KMS, sample policy to provide: {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/auric-ci"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}. tell them not to include session suffix.

Diego Ruiz: egress: if their logs host resolves to private IP, we need peering or a transit route. ask them to curl from a bastion in their VPC and from our NAT to compare.

Liam Park: asked for both curl outputs and the get-caller-identity. also offered a 20m pairing call to apply the policy with them.

infra-bot: Note: private onboarding checklist updated at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-onboard  2026-03-21

Noor Khan: customer provided sts output: arn:aws:sts::998877665544:assumed-role/auric-ci/runner-7. forwarded instructions to replace principal with role arn.

Diego Ruiz: they applied change and re-ran pipeline: KMS step passed. one log flush still fails with TLS alert. asking for client cert and verbose curl output.

Liam Park: flagged renewal risk: onboarding SLA day 8; if unresolved in 36h escalate to AM. I will log CS-5110 for tracking.

Noor Khan: agreed. I'll stay on the ticket for the pairing call. closing loop here until they share cert output. :white_check_mark:
